purchasingPower.strategicImpact: #1 in NFC. Lets SF absorb 9/18ths prorated 2026 base salaries directly on 1-year rentals—keeping draft compensation down to Day 3 instead of paying sellers to eat cash.
Unused 2026 cap rolls over 1-for-1 under CBA Article 13 to neutralize the 2027 deficit. Expiring 2026 rentals ($0 2027 cap) or cheap rookie deals are mandatory over multi-year veteran guarantees.

Own 2027 4th-round pick went to Indianapolis for DT DeForest Buckner and 2027 6th-round pick (via BAL) went to Indianapolis for WR Keenan Allen. Protecting Day 1–2 selections (#31, #63, #95) is vital to supply rookie-scale starters against 2027 cap tightness.

completed2026Moves.analysis: Veteran 6'2" chain-moving route technician (40 rec, 351 yds, 1 TD, 20 first downs, +6.98 EPA in 8g) acquired on an expiring 1-year rental ($0 2027 cap) to stabilize Brock Purdy's intermediate third-down passing game while Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Sr. recover.
Reunites an elite 6'7" All-Pro interior disruptor (4.0 sacks, 8 QB hits in 7g; $7.90M 2026 cap hit absorbed) with Nick Bosa under DC Raheem Morris, keeping Mykel Williams on the edge full-time.
High-motor penetrating 3-technique (2.0 sacks, 7 QB hits) who carried interior pass-rush disruption during Bosa's Weeks 3–7 absence.

topNeeds.epaContext: Mike Evans (27 rec, 420 yds, +40.9 EPA — Out, Ribs/Achilles) and Deebo Samuel Sr. (16 rec, 206 yds — Out, Hamstring) are ruled Out on the active roster, while Christian Kirk (IR — Meniscus), Ricky Pearsall (Season-Ending IR — PCL), De'Zhaun Stribling (IR — Ankle), and Brandon Aiyuk (Reserve/Left Squad) remain sidelined and depth WRs Jacob Cowing (-5.4 EPA) and Brandin Cooks (-2.3 EPA) have struggled. Schefter & Rapoport confirm SF is canvassing both vertical/slot WRs and 12-personnel move TEs alongside George Kittle.

2nd-year LG Connor Colby regressed against top fronts (surrendering 12 pressures in Weeks 5–7 vs. 8 in Weeks 1–4), and relying on rookie 4th-round college OT Carver Willis inside for a 7-1 playoff run is risky—especially after NFC West rival Seattle (5-4) traded for All-Pro LG Quenton Nelson.

Acquiring DeForest Buckner alongside Osa Odighizuwa keeps Mykel Williams (1.0 sack) outside full-time with returning Nick Bosa, Keion White (3.5 sacks), and rookie Romello Height (1.5 sacks). SF is monitoring expiring 1-year edge rentals to guarantee 4-man January pressure under DC Raheem Morris.

After moving on from Jack Jones ($1.08M dead cap), backup slot/dime DB Ashtyn Davis has struggled behind Deommodore Lenoir, Renardo Green, Questionable rookie Upton Stout (shoulder), and IR-return Nate Hobbs (groin), forcing snaps onto 5th-round rookie Ephesians Prysock.

pitfallsToAvoid.trap: Sacrificing 2027 Day-2 Picks (#63, #95) for Contender Pipe Dreams
pitfallsToAvoid.examples: Brian Thomas Jr. (JAX 6-2), Garrett Wilson (NYJ), Landon Dickerson (PHI 6-2)
pitfallsToAvoid.whyAvoid: Jacksonville and Philadelphia are playoff buyers, and burning Round 2 or 3 picks after trading SF's 2027 4th for DeForest Buckner would leave zero picks between #63 and #170 entering a -$31.54M 2027 cap squeeze.

pitfallsToAvoid.trap: Unproductive Aging Pass-Rushers on Past Name Value
pitfallsToAvoid.examples: Cameron Jordan (NO DE, Age 37 — 0.0 Sacks, 1 QB Hit in 7 Games)
pitfallsToAvoid.whyAvoid: Paying draft capital for a 37-year-old edge defender with zero sacks in 2026 provides no third-down burst upgrade over Mykel Williams, Keion White, or rookie Romello Height.

pitfallsToAvoid.examples: Michael Mayer (LV TE — Extended 3 Yrs, $45M w/ $30M Guaranteed)
pitfallsToAvoid.whyAvoid: Las Vegas locked Mayer into a $15M/yr extension before Week 1 to co-anchor Klint Kubiak's 12-personnel offense (36 rec, 351 yds in 2026); he is no longer an expendable rookie-deal backup.

tieredRumors.sources: Adam Schefter, Ian Rapoport, Matt Barrows
tieredRumors.summary: With six WRs sidelined and $39.18M in 2026 cap space, SF is canvassing sellers for both vertical/slot WRs (Downs, Mitchell, Bateman) and pass-catching 12-personnel TEs (Dulcich) while absorbing 2026 salary to keep pick costs to Day 3.
Brandon Aiyuk met with 49ers brass Friday seeking reinstatement; both sides working toward a structured resolution rather than contentious grievances.

Because SF projects at -$31.54M on the 2027 cap with 6 draft picks left (post-Buckner Rd 4 trade), Paraag Marathe is prioritizing expiring 2026 contracts ($0 2027 cap) so ~$28M–$31M+ rolls over under CBA Article 13.
